notes: EmbeddingGemma 2 Transcribe, LiteRT form: the audio encoder of google/embeddinggemma-2 (rev 914f7f89; Gemma 4 audio tower + embed_audio) exported to raw LiteRT graphs with an fp16-safe rewrite of its RMSNorm sites (per-site 2^-k rescale, eps x 4^-k, rsqrt clamp, attention mask -30000; bit-identical to the float32 model in fp32), fp16 weights (FLOAT_CASTING on FC / CONV_2D / DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D), one signature per file (audio_30s / audio_10s: mel float32 [1, F, 128] + mask -> soft tokens [1, F/4, 512] + mask), plus reader v2 (a 6-layer transformer over the soft tokens, 19,573,762 parameters, trained with CTC on LibriSpeech 960 h: mlboydaisuke/EmbeddingGemma-2-Transcribe-Reader revision de224fd8, reader.pt sha256 d605f6fb…; the 200,000-word table FC and ARG_MAX in-graph; reader v1's inputs, outputs and file names) = speech to words on the phone.
